name: patient_is_semi_professional_soccer_player
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is a semi-professional soccer player.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is a semi-professional soccer player.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is not a semi-professional soccer player.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is a semi-professional soccer player.

name: patient_soccer_value_recorded_inthehistory_withunit_minutes
meaning: Numeric value representing the duration in minutes of the patient's participation in a soccer game at any time in their history.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient has not participated in a soccer game or if the duration is unknown or indeterminate.
when_value: Set to the duration in minutes if the patient has participated in a soccer game and the duration is known.

name: patient_experience_of_practicing_soccer_duration_value_in_years
meaning: Numeric value representing the total years of the patient's experience practicing soccer.
when_unknown: Set to null if the duration of the patient's experience practicing soccer is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the total number of years the patient has experience practicing soccer, as documented or reported.

name: patient_has_experience_of_practicing_soccer
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has any experience practicing soccer.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has any experience practicing soccer, regardless of duration.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has no experience practicing soccer at all.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has any experience practicing soccer.

name: patient_is_goalkeeper
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is a goalkeeper.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is a goalkeeper.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is not a goalkeeper.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is a goalkeeper.

name: patient_is_injured_player_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently an injured player.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently an injured player.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not an injured player.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently an injured player.
